themes.theme: Proposed Ban on Berried Lobster and Crawfish
themes.reason: Defines the core intervention mechanism itself (the legal instrument, scope, vessels and waters covered), which is the foundation for how implementation will proceed and explains why this method of amending existing SI was chosen.

Explains the process for deciding and refining implementation details, including testing assumptions and gathering stakeholder input, directly addressing the should-explain point about the method for deciding how to deliver the intervention.

Describes how the ban will actually be enforced (testing kits, routine inspections, regulatory amendment) and who is responsible, which is central to explaining how the intervention will be rolled out.
Provides the detailed cost estimates and assumptions behind enforcement implementation, directly addressing the should-explain point about costs and the assumptions behind those calculations.
Notes potential offsetting savings for some IFCAs, contributing to the cost-benefit picture but as an unquantified side note rather than a load-bearing part of the argument.
A brief remark about simplifying legislation that supports but does not carry the core implementation argument.
A passing remark repeating the legislative simplification point, background context rather than a point the implementation argument rests on.
